the author's own proof environment immediately following the lemma: for V in Y_etale a locally closed subset finite over V is a closed immersion into X_V by separatedness of f, finite unions of such closed subschemes remain finite over V so the colimit defining f_{p!}F(V) is directed and equals the set of sections with support finite over V; since closed subsets proper over V are finite over V when f is locally quasi-finite this equals f_!F(V) by definition (source lines 1131-1145)
